verdict.rationale: Brex docs explicitly reference budgets, spend limits, and auto-enforced controls (brex-docs-6) plus a Team API to manage users, departments, and cards and a Budgets API for allocating spend limits programmatically (brex-docs-2, brex-docs-4), supporting per-card/employee controls. However, evidence lacks detail on granularity (e.g., per-category, per-merchant limits) or first-party UI walkthroughs, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific control-setting workflow exists. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of granular control types (per-category/vendor/time-based limits), independent verification of the control-setting UX, and hands-on confirmation of enforcement behavior.
